page: Microsoft Azure M208s_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 208 vCPUs mapped to 104 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8280L processor with x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 2850.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 13.7 GB of memory per core, alongside 4194 GB of local storage. It is Premium Storage capable but does not include dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks reveal a distinct contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. While single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, the massive core count drives multi-core performance into the top 10% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and stress-ng multi-core tests demonstrate exceptional throughput. Memory bandwidth is a primary strength, with cached read speeds reaching 10456.14 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 415.52 GB/sec, both ranking in the top 10%. Redis SET operations also achieve top-tier performance at 153.96 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server represents a high-density resource profile designed to consolidate massive enterprise workloads rather than run single-threaded tasks. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local storage make it highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise relational database management systems, heavy multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput Redis caching layers.
